bluf: Al Jazeera reported that at least eight Palestinians, including a four-year-old, were killed in Israeli drone attacks across Gaza. France 24 reported residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky reached Ukrainian-held territory after a rare local truce. Iran's supreme leader warned the United States and Israel against further strikes amid tensions over a possible return to fighting.

items.text: France 24 reported that residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky reached Ukrainian-held territory following a rare local truce; the event time was not stated.
Bulgarians voted Sunday in a presidential runoff amid Black Sea tensions; reports also cited economic challenges and attacks on ships.
Reuters reported that Russia would build a 2GW nuclear power plant in Ghana.
According to Al Jazeera, at least eight Palestinians, including a four-year-old, were killed in Israeli drone attacks across the Gaza Strip; the event time was not stated.
France 24 reported that Iran's supreme leader warned the United States and Israel against further strikes as tensions mounted over a possible return to fighting.
